# LCARdS 2026.10.0-dev.3 documentation

Source: https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/. JSON Schemas: https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/schema/index.json

---

<!-- https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/ai-assistance.html -->

# Getting AI Help

An AI assistant can write LCARdS cards and whole dashboards for you. It just needs to know LCARdS first.

- Out of the box, a chatbot has never seen LCARdS. It guesses, and guessed options are silently ignored.
- Give it the real list of LCARdS options and it stops guessing.
- Check what it wrote before you paste it into Home Assistant.

## With Claude (easiest)

The **LCARdS skill** teaches Claude everything for your LCARdS version: every option, every built-in preset and colour, the docs, the gallery dashboards and the config checker. It also knows [HA-LCARS](https://github.com/th3jesta/ha-lcars): its themes, its `--lcars-*` colour variables and its classes for stock cards. It also knows the [UIX](https://github.com/Lint-Free-Technology/uix) styling HA-LCARS runs on, so it can tell you which job belongs to an LCARdS option, the theme or UIX.

1. Add the skill to Claude:
   - **Claude Code:** install the LCARdS plugin. In a Claude Code session, run:

     ```
     /plugin marketplace add https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/marketplace.json
     /plugin install lcards@lcards
     ```

   - **claude.ai or the Claude apps:** download [`lcards-skill.zip`](/tools/lcards-skill.zip) and upload it as a custom skill in **Settings** (needs code execution turned on).
2. Ask. For example:
   - "Make me an LCARdS button for `light.kitchen` that turns red when it's on."
   - "Build an engineering dashboard with my `sensor.power_*` entities."

Claude asks for your real entity ids instead of inventing them, and checks its own YAML before handing it over. Running HA-LCARS? Say which theme, and Claude colours the cards with the theme's own variables so they follow when you switch themes.

In Claude Code the plugin goes further:

- The config checker **runs by itself** every time Claude writes a YAML file with LCARdS cards in it, and Claude fixes whatever it reports before handing the file over.
- **`/lcards:check`** followed by a file or pasted YAML checks it and explains each problem.
- **`/lcards:dashboard`** builds a whole dashboard with you, one question at a time.

::: details Keeping the Claude Code plugin up to date
Each LCARdS release comes with a new version of the plugin. To get it, run `/plugin marketplace update lcards`, or open `/plugin`, go to **Marketplaces**, select **lcards** and turn on **Enable auto-update**. Run `/reload-plugins` (or start a new session) to load the new version.

- **Running a dev build of LCARdS?** Use the dev channel instead, which follows the [dev docs](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/): `/plugin marketplace add https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/marketplace.json`, then `/plugin install lcards@lcards-dev`. Install one channel, not both.
- **Installed the skill by hand before?** Delete `~/.claude/skills/lcards/` first, so only the plugin copy loads.
- **Prefer a manual install?** Unzip [`lcards-skill.zip`](/tools/lcards-skill.zip) into `~/.claude/skills/`, so you have `~/.claude/skills/lcards/SKILL.md`. It won't update itself.
- The plugin needs Claude Code 2.1.224 or newer.
:::

::: info Other tools that support skills
The LCARdS skill follows the open [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) standard, so any tool that supports Agent Skills can load the same zip. We build and test it with Claude.
:::

::: tip Claude can check YAML too
Already have a config, from you or from another tool? Paste it into Claude with the skill loaded and ask *"check this LCARdS config and fix it"*. Claude runs the same checker as the [Check Your Config](config-checker) page and explains each problem.
:::

## Give Claude your home's context (ha-mcp)

On its own, Claude doesn't know your Home Assistant: you tell it your entity ids. The community [**ha-mcp**](https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp) server connects Claude to your Home Assistant, so together with the LCARdS skill Claude can look things up for itself:

- your **areas and floors**, to group a dashboard by room;
- your **entities** and their current **states**, so it uses your real entity ids;
- which devices are lights, sensors, switches and so on, to pick the right card for each.

Then ask, for example: *"Build an LCARdS engineering dashboard for the devices in my garage"* or *"Make a bridge view with a button for every light on the ground floor."*

::: warning ha-mcp is not part of LCARdS
ha-mcp is a separate community project; we don't make, support or take responsibility for it. It can also change your Home Assistant (automations, dashboards, settings and more). If you only want Claude to read your setup, turn on its **Read Only Mode**, or connect with its read-only URL (append `/readonly` to the server address). Install and set it up by following [its own instructions](https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp).
:::

## With other assistants

If your assistant supports Agent Skills, use the skill above. Otherwise:

1. **Download the option list for your card**, for example [`lcards-button.json`](/schema/cards/lcards-button.json). Every card is listed in [`schema/index.json`](/schema/index.json).
2. **Attach it** to your chat and paste this first:

   ```
   I'm writing YAML for LCARdS, a custom Home Assistant card system. The
   attached JSON Schema lists every option. Only use options from the schema.
   If something I ask for isn't there, tell me instead of inventing a key.
   Theme colours need the theme: prefix, e.g. theme:colors.ui.primary.
   ```

3. **Describe the card you want.**

## Check what it wrote

- Paste the YAML into [Check Your Config](config-checker). It runs in your browser and points at each problem.
- Or ask Claude with the skill to check it (see the tip above).
- Prefer the command line? Download [`lcards-validate.mjs`](/tools/lcards-validate.mjs) and run `node lcards-validate.mjs my-dashboard.yaml` (Node.js 20 or newer).

## If it still makes things up

- Paste the checker's output back into the chat and ask it to fix exactly those lines.
- Remind it to re-read the attached schema and not to guess. Most assistants correct themselves once told.

## Details for power users

::: details What else you can attach

**Schemas**

- **One card at a time (smallest):** the card's file from [`schema/index.json`](/schema/index.json), plus the shared files its entry lists under `uses` (rules, animations, background animations, state colours, filters). Card files are 2 to 75 KB; attach only the shared files your request touches.
- **Everything in one file:** [`lcards-schema.json`](/lcards-schema.json) holds every card, the [Layout View](../cards/layout-view/) and the LCARS shell strategy. It is about 460 KB, so it suits tools with large context windows.
- Each GitHub release carries both (`lcards-schema.json`, `lcards-schema.zip`), plus the skill and the checker, matching that release exactly.

**Docs pages**

- [Common Properties](../cards/common) explains what the schema can't: entity references, the `theme:` prefix, `{{ }}` templates and actions.
- The card's own page (for example [Button](../cards/button/) or [Chart](../cards/chart/)) has worked examples.
- Tools that read [`llms.txt`](/llms.txt) find everything from there. [`llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt) is all the user docs in one file.

**MSD**

The MSD schema (`custom:lcards-msd-card`) is large and deeply nested. Attach [`lcards-msd-card.json`](/schema/cards/lcards-msd-card.json) with the shared files it uses, plus the [MSD Quick Start](../cards/msd/quick-start) or [Routing Concepts](../cards/msd/routing-concepts) page, and expect a few more rounds than for a single button.

**Longer prompt template**

```
I'm writing YAML configuration for LCARdS, a custom Home Assistant Lovelace
card system. I've attached its JSON Schema (from https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/schema/index.json)
and reference docs. Rules:
- Only use properties that appear in the schema for the card type I'm using
  (resolve "#/$defs/..." refs within the file, and "../shared/<name>.json" refs
  against the shared files I attached).
- Do not invent properties. If something I ask for isn't in the schema, tell
  me instead of guessing at a plausible-sounding key.
- Colour values must match the schema's colour pattern: hex, rgb()/rgba()/
  hsl()/hsla(), var(--name), or a theme:path token (e.g. theme:colors.ui.primary).
```

:::

# Building a Dashboard

How to go from single cards to a whole LCARS screen. The [Dashboard Gallery](dashboard-gallery) shows finished examples built this way; this page explains the choices behind them. For the look itself (frames, colour roles, the Picard and classic styles, ready-made patterns), see [Designing LCARS Screens](lcars-design).

## Pick the cards

| You want | Use | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| The LCARS frame: corners, bars, headers | [Elbow](../cards/elbow/) | `header-left`/`footer-left` corners, `frame` for a full border; text labels sit on the bars |
| Buttons, labels, status pills | [Button](../cards/button/) | Presets for the classic shapes; `component: dpad` or `alert` for the D-pad and the alert symbol |
| A value you can set or read at a glance | [Slider](../cards/slider-card/) | Pills, gauges, shaped and Picard styles; read-only on sensors |
| Pick one of several options | [Select Menu](../cards/select-menu/) | One button per `input_select` option |
| Rows of readings | [Data Grid](../cards/data-grid/) | Entities, templates and data sources in a table; decorative mode for LCARS number blocks |
| History | [Chart](../cards/chart/) | Entity history, statistics or data sources |
| A ship or floor plan with live controls | [MSD](../cards/msd/) | Cards placed on an SVG, wired with routed lines |
| A full-screen alert | [Alert Overlay](../cards/alert-overlay/) | Shows over the view while an alert mode is active |
| The screen itself | [Layout View](../cards/layout-view/) | A CSS grid for the whole view; [Layout Card](../cards/layout-card/) for a grid inside one area |

## Lay out the screen

Build the view on a [Layout View](../cards/layout-view/): name the regions in `grid-template-areas`, then put each card in one with `view_layout: { grid-area: ... }`.

```yaml
views:
  - title: Bridge
    path: bridge
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))   # fill the screen below HA's toolbar
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 6px
      grid-template-columns: 170px minmax(0, 1fr)
      grid-template-rows: 64px 54px 54px minmax(0, 1fr) 64px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "header header"
        "nav1   main"
        "nav2   main"
        "filler main"
        "footer footer"
    cards:
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 170     # the same width as the sidebar column
            bar_height: 22
        view_layout:
          grid-area: header
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: lozenge
        text:
          label:
            content: LIGHTS
            show: true
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nav1
```

Things that make the difference:

- **Match the frame to the sidebar.** Give the header and footer elbows a `bar_width` equal to the sidebar column, so the bars line up with the buttons below.
- **`minmax(0, 1fr)`, not `1fr`,** for columns and rows that hold a chart, an MSD or a grid. A plain `1fr` can't shrink below its content, and the view overflows the screen.
- **Fixed heights for button rows** (`54px`), the flexible track (`minmax(0, 1fr)`) for the area that should take the rest.
- **Some cards draw to their cell's height:** the D-pad, the alert symbol, Picard and shaped sliders. Give them a cell whose height suits them; a tall cell makes a D-pad wider than its column. `justify-self: center` in `view_layout` centres one in a wide area.
- **Data grids stretch their rows** to fill the area. Set `grid-auto-rows` (and `align-content: start`) under the card's `grid:` for a compact table.
- **Lozenge buttons hide their label** by design; set `text.label.show: true` when the button should say something. For a title on an elbow, set its `position` (for example `bottom-right`) and a `color`.
- **Fill leftover space** with a `panel-dark` button or a decorative data grid instead of leaving holes in the frame.

## Recipes

### A status that changes colour at a threshold

A rule on the card itself: the card's `id` is the target, and higher `priority` wins when both rules match.

```yaml
type: custom:lcards-button
id: reactor_status
entity: sensor.reactor_temperature
preset: lozenge
text:
  label:
    content: "REACTOR {{ states('sensor.reactor_temperature') | int }} °C"
    show: true
rules:
  - id: reactor-hot
    priority: 20
    when:
      entity: sensor.reactor_temperature
      above: 80
    apply:
      overlays:
        reactor_status:
          style:
            card:
              color:
                background: var(--lcars-alert-red, #cc0000)
  - id: reactor-warm
    priority: 10
    when:
      entity: sensor.reactor_temperature
      above: 60
    apply:
      overlays:
        reactor_status:
          style:
            card:
              color:
                background: var(--lcars-alert-yellow, #ffcc00)
```

See [Rules](../core/rules/) for conditions (time ranges, templates, `all`/`any`) and for restyling other cards by tag.

### A smoothed live reading with its history

A [data source](../core/datasources/) keeps recent values and runs processors over them. Show the smoothed value in text with `{ds:name.processor}` and chart the raw and smoothed buffers together.

```yaml
type: custom:lcards-chart
data_sources:
  deck_temp:
    entity: sensor.deck_temperature
    history:
      hours: 6
    processing:
      smoothed:
        type: smooth
        method: exponential
        alpha: 0.3
sources:
  - datasource: deck_temp
    name: Raw
  - datasource: deck_temp
    buffer: smoothed
    name: Smoothed
```

```yaml
type: custom:lcards-button
preset: lozenge
text:
  label:
    content: "DECK {ds:deck_temp.smoothed:.1f} °C"   # the data source defined on the chart
    show: true
```

Data source names are shared across the dashboard, so the button reads the source the chart defines. `{ds:deck_temp}` without a format shows the raw value with its unit.

### A screen that follows alert mode

LCARdS cards already recolour themselves when an [alert mode](../core/alert-mode) is active. Add the overlay for the full-screen effect and buttons that raise and clear an alert through the `lcards.*` [actions](../configuration/ha-actions):

```yaml
type: custom:lcards-layout-card
layout:
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr
  grid-gap: 6px
cards:
  - type: custom:lcards-alert-overlay
  - type: custom:lcards-button
    preset: lozenge
    text:
      label:
        content: RED ALERT
        show: true
    tap_action:
      action: perform-action
      service: lcards.red_alert
  - type: custom:lcards-button
    preset: lozenge
    text:
      label:
        content: STAND DOWN
        show: true
    tap_action:
      action: perform-action
      service: lcards.clear_alert
```

Automations can react to the alert level too: `input_select.lcards_alert_mode` always holds the current mode.

## Check it

Before saving a dashboard, paste it into [Check Your Config](config-checker). It reports keys LCARdS doesn't have and names that don't exist (a misspelt preset, animation or theme token), each at its path in the YAML.

Want help writing it? [Getting AI Help](ai-assistance) shows how to have Claude or another assistant write the YAML for you.

<!-- https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/cb-lcars-migration.html -->

# Coming from CB-LCARS

LCARdS originates from, and supersedes, the [CB-LCARS](https://github.com/snootched/cb-lcars) project.

CB-LCARS was based on [Custom Button Card](https://github.com/custom-cards/button-card); LCARdS is built from scratch with Lit and needs no other custom cards.

Most features have been ported to LCARdS. Use the table to find the LCARdS equivalent of each CB-LCARS card or feature.

::: tip You can run both simultaneously
CB-LCARS and LCARdS can coexist while you transition. All new features and fixes will be made in LCARdS only going forward.

The configuration formats differ, so card configs don't carry over directly.
:::

## Feature Comparison

✅ Present | ❌ Not present | ⚠️ Partial

| Feature | CB-LCARS | LCARdS | Notes |
|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| Buttons | ✅ `cb-lcars-button-card` | ✅ `lcards-button` | Built-in `preset` collection provides the standard LCARS button styles, which are completely configurable. |
| Multi-Segment Buttons | ❌ | ✅ `lcards-button` | Allows complex button designs (known as `component`) to be used as advanced multi-segment/multi-touch controls, configured via `segments`. |
| DPAD | ✅ `cb-lcars-dpad-card` | ✅ `lcards-button` | First advanced button to use the `component` feature of `lcards-button`. |
| ALERT | ⚠️ background animation | ✅ `lcards-button` | Promoted to a button card component: allows full interactive configuration. |
| Labels | ✅ `cb-lcars-label-card` | ✅ `lcards-button` | Label functionality is available via `lcards-button`. Additional presets available for text labels with or without decoration. |
| Elbows | ✅ `cb-lcars-elbow-card` | ✅ `lcards-elbow` | Equivalent in LCARdS: enhanced with more corner styles (e.g. straight cut with configurable angles). |
| Double Elbows | ✅ `cb-lcars-double-elbow-card` | ✅ `lcards-elbow` | Double Elbow functionality is now consolidated into a single unified `lcards-elbow` card. |
| Sliders | ✅ `cb-lcars-multimeter-card` | ✅ `lcards-slider` | Completely replacing the former multimeter card. Vastly improved: configurable direction, inversion, display min/max, control min/max, and more. |
| Cascade Data Grid | ⚠️ background animation | ✅ `lcards-data-grid` | CB-LCARS provided a decorative-only version as a background animation. `lcards-data-grid` is a full-featured grid that can show real entity data, text, etc. Decorative mode is still available. |
| Text | ✅ `cb-lcars-text-card` | ✅ `lcards-button` | Text-only button presets, or text fields on any card. |
| Picard-style controls | ✅ `cb-lcars-picard-card` | ✅ `lcards-elbow`, `lcards-slider` | Segmented (double) elbows and frames on `lcards-elbow`; the `picard` slider component with the `picard-gauge-vertical` preset; `filled` and `outline` button presets. |
| Layouts | ⚠️ `custom:layout-card` (separate install) | ✅ `lcards-layout-card`, `lcards-layout-view` | LCARdS has its own grid layouts with visual editors. Replace `custom:layout-card` with `lcards-layout-card`: change the `type` and remove `layout_type`; the `layout` and `view_layout` keys stay the same. See [Layout Card](../cards/layout-card/). |
| Select menu | ❌ | ✅ `lcards-select-menu` | A grid of buttons for an `input_select` or `select` entity. |
| card-mod | ⚠️ required | ✅ not needed | LCARdS needs no other custom cards or card-mod. |
| Charts / Graphs | ❌ | ✅ `lcards-chart` | Embedded ApexCharts library providing 15+ chart types to plot entity/data. |
| MSD (Master Systems Display) | ❌ | ✅ `lcards-msd` | Full MSD system in a card. Embed controls, connect routing lines, add animations to reflect statuses. |
| Background Animations | ✅ GRID, ALERT, GEO Array, Pulsewave | ⚠️ ✅ | Background animations split into stackable layers: mix and match building blocks. ✅ GRID (enhanced), ✅ ALERT (button component), ✅ Starfield & Nebula (enhanced). ⚠️ GEO Array, Pulsewave (pending). |
| Element Animations | ❌ | ✅ | Embedded Anime.js v4 enabling animation of any SVG element (cards, lines/stroke, text, etc.). |
| Symbiont (embedded cards) | ✅ | ✅ | Available in Elbow card: attempts native card injection for basic style imprinting. Add `card_mod` config for advanced styling. |
| State-based Styling / Custom States | ✅ | ✅✅ | CB-LCARS has a limited set of states. LCARdS uses common state groupings (`default` \| `active` \| `inactive` \| `unavailable`) plus the ability to define ***any state*** for customised styling. Integrates with the core rules engine for hot-patching. |
| Sounds | ❌ | ✅ | Customisable sounds for many UI and card event types (tap, double tap, hold, hover, sidebar expand/collapse, and more). |
| Alert Overlay | ❌ | ✅ `lcards-alert-overlay` | Dashboard-level card that reacts to `input_select.lcards_alert_mode` and displays a full-screen configurable backdrop with an embedded content card. |

# Check Your Config

Paste your YAML below to find the mistakes LCARdS would otherwise silently ignore.

- **Works with:** one card, a view, or a whole dashboard.
- **Finds:** options that don't exist, misspelt preset, animation and colour names, and values of the wrong kind.
- **Private:** it runs in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

<ClientOnly>

</ClientOnly>

## Where to get your YAML

- **One card:** open the card editor and switch to its **YAML** tab, then copy everything.
- **A whole dashboard:** **Edit dashboard > ⋮ > Raw configuration editor**, then copy everything.

## Reading the results

- **Errors** are things LCARdS will reject or ignore. Fix these.
- **Warnings** are names LCARdS doesn't know (a preset, animation, sound or theme colour), almost always a typo. The checker suggests the closest match. A warning about an older chart or data grid format means the config still works but can be updated.
- Each result shows the option's path and line, and links to the docs for that option.

## Other ways to check

- **Ask Claude:** with the [LCARdS skill](ai-assistance#with-claude-easiest) loaded, paste your YAML and ask *"check this LCARdS config and fix it"*. Claude runs this same checker, explains each problem and gives you the corrected YAML.
- **Command line:** download [`lcards-validate.mjs`](/tools/lcards-validate.mjs) and run `node lcards-validate.mjs my-dashboard.yaml` (Node.js 20 or newer). Add `--json` for machine-readable output.
- **In Home Assistant:** each LCARdS card editor shows schema problems at the top of the editor as you edit.

# Dashboard Gallery

Complete dashboards, not single cards: each one is a whole view built from LCARdS cards on a [Layout View](../cards/layout-view/), recorded in Home Assistant while its entities change (lights switch, levels move, alerts sound). Copy one, swap in your own entities, and build from there.

To use one:

1. Create a dashboard (**Settings > Dashboards > Add dashboard**), open it, then **Edit dashboard > Raw configuration editor**.
2. Paste the YAML and save.
3. Replace the `lcards_test_*` helpers and the sample temperature sensor with your own entities.
4. Paste your version into [Check Your Config](config-checker) before you save it.

They look best with an [HA-LCARS](https://github.com/th3jesta/ha-lcars) theme, and need no other custom cards.

## Bridge

An LCARS frame (header and footer elbows, a sidebar of buttons) around a status grid, two sliders, a toggle and a history chart.

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/bridge.webm" poster="/gallery/bridge.webp" title="Bridge dashboard: sidebar buttons, a status grid, power and shields sliders, a lights button and a temperature chart" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Bridge: an LCARS frame (header and footer elbows, a sidebar of buttons) around a
# main panel with a status grid, controls and a chart. Uses lcards_test_* helpers
# and a temperature sensor; swap in your own entities. Best with an HA-LCARS theme.
title: Bridge
views:
  - title: Bridge
    path: bridge
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 6px
      grid-template-columns: 170px 1fr 1fr 1fr
      grid-template-rows: 64px 54px 54px 54px 54px 54px 1fr 64px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "header  header  header  header"
        "nav1    status  status  status"
        "nav2    status  status  status"
        "nav3    status  status  status"
        "nav4    power   shields lights"
        "nav5    power   shields lights"
        "filler  chart   chart   chart"
        "footer  footer  footer  footer"
    cards:
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 170
            bar_height: 22
        text:
          title:
            content: BRIDGE OPERATIONS
            position: bottom-right
            font_size: 24
            color: var(--lcards-orange)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: header
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_toggle
        text:
          name:
            content: RED ALERT
        tap_action:
          action: toggle
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nav1
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
        text:
          name:
            content: LIGHTS
        tap_action:
          action: toggle
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nav2
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
        text:
          name:
            content: DOORS
        tap_action:
          action: toggle
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nav3
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_select.lcards_test_mode
        text:
          name:
            content: MODE
        tap_action:
          action: more-info
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nav4
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields
        text:
          name:
            content: SHIELDS
        tap_action:
          action: more-info
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nav5
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: panel-dark
        view_layout:
          grid-area: filler
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [SYSTEM, STATUS, LEVEL]
            header: true
          - [WARP CORE, "{{ 'ONLINE' if states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | float > 0 else 'OFFLINE' }}", "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int }} %"]
          - [SHIELDS, "{{ 'RAISED' if states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | float > 50 else 'LOW' }}", "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int }} %"]
          - [CABIN TEMP, NOMINAL, "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_temperature') }} °C"]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr
          gap: 4px
        style:
          font_size: 18px
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: var(--lcars-orange)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: status
      - type: custom:lcards-slider
        entity: input_number.lcards_test_power
        preset: pills-basic
        view_layout:
          grid-area: power
      - type: custom:lcards-slider
        entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields
        preset: gauge-basic
        view_layout:
          grid-area: shields
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: lozenge
        entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
        icon: mdi:lightbulb-group
        text:
          label:
            content: MAIN LIGHTS
            show: true
        tap_action:
          action: toggle
        view_layout:
          grid-area: lights
      - type: custom:lcards-chart
        sources:
          - entity: sensor.desk_sensor_temperature
            name: Deck temperature
        view_layout:
          grid-area: chart
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow

            bar_height: 22

          grid-area: footer
```

## Engineering

A [Master Systems Display](../cards/msd/) of the built-in NCC-1701-A blueprint in a Picard-era frame. Shield arcs around the ship change colour with shield strength, and three controls are joined to the ship's own bridge, warp core and shuttle bay markers by routed lines. Square sidebar buttons, a tick band, a systems table and Picard sliders surround it.

## Alert mode

Buttons that raise and clear an [alert mode](../core/alert-mode) through the `lcards.*` [actions](../configuration/ha-actions), beside an everyday systems screen. The [alert overlay](../cards/alert-overlay/) covers the view with the symbol for the active alert: red, then yellow.

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/alert.webm" poster="/gallery/alert.webp" title="Alert dashboard: alert buttons beside a systems table, a data cascade and a chart; red alert covers it with the red overlay, then yellow alert with the yellow one" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Alert mode: buttons that raise and clear LCARdS alert modes (the lcards.* actions
# recolour every LCARdS dashboard) beside an everyday systems screen, and the alert
# overlay that covers the view while an alert is active.
title: Alert Mode
views:
  - title: Alert
    path: alert
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 6px
      grid-template-columns: 170px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr)
      grid-template-rows: 64px 70px 70px 70px 70px minmax(0, 1fr) 64px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "header header header"
        "red    status status"
        "yellow status status"
        "blue   status status"
        "clear  status status"
        "filler grid   chart"
        "footer footer footer"
    cards:
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 170
            bar_height: 22
        text:
          title:
            content: ALERT STATUS
            position: bottom-right
            font_size: 24
            color: var(--lcards-orange)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: header
      # Shown over the view while an alert is active (no size: 60% x 50% of the screen).
      - type: custom:lcards-alert-overlay
        view_layout:
          grid-area: status
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [SYSTEM, STATUS, LEVEL]
            header: true
          - [MAIN POWER, "{{ 'ONLINE' if states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int > 20 else 'LOW' }}", "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int }} %"]
          - [SHIELDS, "{{ 'RAISED' if states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int > 0 else 'DOWN' }}", "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int }} %"]
          - [DOORS, "{{ 'OPEN' if is_state('input_boolean.lcards_test_doors', 'on') else 'SECURED' }}", ""]
          - [MODE, input_select.lcards_test_mode, ""]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: repeat(5, min-content)
          gap: 6px
        style:
          font_size: 22px
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: var(--lcars-orange)
          - style:
              align: right
          - style:
              align: right
        view_layout:
          grid-area: status
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        data_mode: decorative
        format: digit
        refresh_interval: 1500
        refresh_cells: 0.2
        grid:
          grid-template-rows: repeat(6, auto)
          grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr)
          gap: 0px
        style:
          font_size: 20px
          color: var(--lcars-blue)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: grid
      - type: custom:lcards-chart
        chart_type: line
        graph_span: 12h
        sources:
          - entity: sensor.desk_sensor_temperature
            name: Deck 4
        view_layout:
          grid-area: chart
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        style:
          card:
            color:
              background:
                default: var(--lcars-alert-red, #cc0000)
        text:
          name:
            content: RED ALERT
        tap_action:
          action: perform-action
          service: lcards.red_alert
        view_layout:
          grid-area: red
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        style:
          card:
            color:
              background:
                default: var(--lcars-alert-yellow, #ffcc00)
        text:
          name:
            content: YELLOW ALERT
        tap_action:
          action: perform-action
          service: lcards.yellow_alert
        view_layout:
          grid-area: yellow
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        style:
          card:
            color:
              background:
                default: var(--lcars-alert-blue, #3366ff)
        text:
          name:
            content: BLUE ALERT
        tap_action:
          action: perform-action
          service: lcards.blue_alert
        view_layout:
          grid-area: blue
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        text:
          name:
            content: STAND DOWN
        tap_action:
          action: perform-action
          service: lcards.clear_alert
        view_layout:
          grid-area: clear
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: panel-dark
        view_layout:
          grid-area: filler
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: footer-left
          segment:
            bar_width: 170
            bar_height: 22
        view_layout:
          grid-area: footer
```
:::

## Picard era

Later LCARS screens (as on the USS Titan) use thinner, double-ringed frames, square-ended buttons, cooler blues and greys, and dense readouts with small orange accents. These two use the same cards in that style.

### Operations

Segmented double elbows, filled buttons that light up with their state, a [select menu](../cards/select-menu/) in the outline style, a cascade of changing hex values, a status table and two Picard sliders.

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/titan-operations.webm" poster="/gallery/titan-operations.webp" title="Operations dashboard: grey double elbows with orange accents framing light and door buttons, a mode selector, a blue cascade of hex numbers, a status table, two vertical Picard sliders and a temperature history" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Titan Operations: the Picard-era look (segmented double elbows, square-ended
# filled and outline buttons, Picard sliders, blue data cascades with orange accents).
# Uses lcards_test_* helpers and a temperature sensor; swap in your own entities.
title: Titan Operations
views:
  - title: Operations
    path: operations
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 6px
      grid-template-columns: 210px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 130px 130px
      grid-template-rows: 80px 52px 52px 52px 52px 140px minmax(0, 1fr) 80px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "header  header  header  header  header"
        "b1      cascade cascade power   shields"
        "b2      cascade cascade power   shields"
        "menu    cascade cascade power   shields"
        "menu    status  status  power   shields"
        "menu    status  status  power   shields"
        "chart   chart   chart   chart   chart"
        "footer  footer  footer  footer  footer"
    cards:
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 6
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 210
              bar_height: 24
              color: var(--lcards-gray-medium)
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 48
              bar_height: 8
              color: var(--lcards-orange-medium)
        text:
          title:
            content: OPERATIONS · DECK 4
            position: bottom-right
            font_size: 26
            color: var(--lcards-blue-light)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: header
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
        style:
          card:
            color:
              background:
                active: var(--lcards-orange)
                inactive: var(--lcards-gray-medium-dark)
        text:
          name:
            content: LIGHTS
        tap_action:
          action: toggle
        view_layout:
          grid-area: b1
      - type: custom:lcards-button
        preset: filled
        entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
        style:
          card:
            color:
              background:
                active: var(--lcards-orange)
                inactive: var(--lcards-gray-medium-dark)
        text:
          name:
            content: DOORS
        tap_action:
          action: toggle
        view_layout:
          grid-area: b2
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        data_mode: decorative
        format: hex
        refresh_interval: 1500
        refresh_cells: 0.15
        grid:
          grid-template-rows: repeat(4, auto)
          grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr)
          gap: 0px
        columns:
          - format: digit
          - format: digit
        style:
          font_size: 22px
          color: var(--lcards-blue-light)
        highlight_changes:
          preset: pulse
          duration: 400
        view_layout:
          grid-area: cascade
      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [SYSTEM, STATUS, LEVEL]
            header: true
          - [MAIN POWER, "{{ 'ONLINE' if states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int > 20 else 'LOW' }}", "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int }} %"]
          - [SHIELDS, "{{ 'RAISED' if states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int > 0 else 'DOWN' }}", "{{ states('input_number.lcards_test_shields') | int }} %"]
          - [MODE, input_select.lcards_test_mode, ""]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: repeat(4, min-content)
          gap: 4px
        style:
          font_size: 18px
          color: var(--lcards-blue-light)
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: var(--lcards-orange)
          - style:
              align: right
          - style:
              align: right
        view_layout:
          grid-area: status
      - type: custom:lcards-slider
        entity: input_number.lcards_test_power
        preset: picard-gauge-vertical
        component: picard
        view_layout:
          grid-area: power
      - type: custom:lcards-slider
        entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields
        preset: picard-gauge-vertical
        component: picard
        view_layout:
          grid-area: shields
      - type: custom:lcards-select-menu
        entity: input_select.lcards_test_mode
        preset: outline
        grid:
          columns: 1
          gap: 6px
        view_layout:
          grid-area: menu
      - type: custom:lcards-chart
        chart_type: area
        graph_span: 24h
        sources:
          - entity: sensor.desk_sensor_temperature
            name: Deck 4
        style:
          colors:
            series:
              - var(--lcards-blue-light)
          fill:
            type: gradient
            gradient:
              opacityFrom: 0.45
              opacityTo: 0.02
        view_layout:
          grid-area: chart
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: footer-left
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 6
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 210
              bar_height: 24
              color: var(--lcards-gray-medium)
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 48
              bar_height: 8
              color: var(--lcards-orange-medium)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: footer
```
:::

### Sciences

Segmented [frames](../cards/elbow/#frame-type) around a history chart with a smoothed [data source](../core/datasources/) trend and a set of radial gauges, a sensor table and hourly averages.

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/sciences.webm" poster="/gallery/sciences.webp" title="Sciences dashboard: a framed temperature history with a smoothed trend line, framed radial gauges for power, shields and humidity, a sensor table and a column chart of hourly averages" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Sciences: Picard-era readouts. Segmented frames around a history chart and a set of
# radial gauges, a sensor table and hourly averages, in cool blues and greys with
# orange accents. Uses lcards_test_* helpers and a temperature sensor.
title: Sciences
views:
  - title: Sciences
    path: sciences
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 8px
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr)
      grid-template-rows: 80px minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 70px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "header  header"
        "history gauges"
        "table   bars"
        "footer  footer"
    cards:
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: header-right
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 6
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 160
              bar_height: 24
              color: var(--lcards-blue-medium-light)
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 40
              bar_height: 8
              color: var(--lcards-orange-medium)
        text:
          title:
            content: SCIENCES · SENSOR ANALYSIS
            position: bottom-left
            font_size: 26
            color: var(--lcards-blue-lightest)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: header

      # History: a segmented frame with the chart inside it.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: frame
          style: segmented
          segment:
            color: var(--lcards-gray-medium)
          frame:
            bar_width: 14
            bar_height: 10
            segments:
              gap: 5
              inner_frame:
                bar_width: 4
                color: var(--lcards-blue-medium-light)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: history
      - type: custom:lcards-chart
        chart_type: area
        graph_span: 24h
        data_sources:
          deck_temp:
            entity: sensor.desk_sensor_temperature
            history:
              hours: 24
            processing:
              smoothed:
                type: smooth
                method: exponential
                alpha: 0.15
        sources:
          - datasource: deck_temp
            name: Deck 4
          - datasource: deck_temp
            buffer: smoothed
            name: Trend
        style:
          colors:
            series:
              - var(--lcards-blue-light)
              - var(--lcards-orange-medium)
          fill:
            type: gradient
            gradient:
              opacityFrom: 0.4
              opacityTo: 0.02
          legend:
            show: true
        view_layout:
          grid-area: history
          margin: 30px 34px

      # Gauges: radial bars for the live levels, in a matching frame.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: frame
          style: segmented
          segment:
            color: var(--lcards-gray-medium)
          frame:
            bar_width: 14
            bar_height: 10
            segments:
              gap: 5
              inner_frame:
                bar_width: 4
                color: var(--lcards-orange-medium)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: gauges
      - type: custom:lcards-chart
        chart_type: radialBar
        sources:
          - entity: input_number.lcards_test_power
            name: Power
          - entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields
            name: Shields
          - entity: input_number.lcards_test_humidity
            name: Humidity
        style:
          colors:
            series:
              - var(--lcards-orange-medium)
              - var(--lcards-blue-light)
              - var(--lcards-blue-medium-light)
          legend:
            show: true
          chart_options:
            plotOptions:
              radialBar:
                startAngle: -135
                endAngle: 135
                hollow:
                  size: 35%
        view_layout:
          grid-area: gauges
          margin: 30px 34px

      - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
        data_mode: data
        rows:
          - values: [SENSOR, READING, STATUS]
            header: true
          - [DECK 4 TEMP, sensor.desk_sensor_temperature, NOMINAL]
          - [CABIN TEMP, input_number.lcards_test_temperature, NOMINAL]
          - [HUMIDITY, input_number.lcards_test_humidity, "{{ 'HIGH' if states('input_number.lcards_test_humidity') | int > 60 else 'NOMINAL' }}"]
          - [POWER, input_number.lcards_test_power, "{{ 'ONLINE' if states('input_number.lcards_test_power') | int > 20 else 'LOW' }}"]
        grid:
          grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: repeat(5, min-content)
          gap: 6px
        style:
          font_size: 20px
          color: var(--lcards-blue-lightest)
        columns:
          - style:
              align: left
              color: var(--lcards-orange-medium)
          - style:
              align: right
          - style:
              align: right
              color: var(--lcards-blue-light)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: table

      - type: custom:lcards-chart
        chart_type: column
        graph_span: 12h
        sources:
          - entity: sensor.desk_sensor_temperature
            name: Hourly average
            group_by:
              func: avg
              duration: 1h
        style:
          colors:
            series:
              - var(--lcards-blue-medium-light)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: bars

      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        elbow:
          type: footer-right
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 6
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 160
              bar_height: 24
              color: var(--lcards-blue-medium-light)
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 40
              bar_height: 8
              color: var(--lcards-orange-medium)
        view_layout:
          grid-area: footer
```
:::

## Built from the design guide

Seven screens composed from the [archetypes](lcars-design#screen-archetypes) and [patterns](lcars-design#patterns) in Designing LCARS Screens, four Picard and three classic. Each starts from a different archetype, so together they show how varied the same design language can be. Every colour is a theme role: they follow your HA-LCARS theme, and the classic ones set a classic theme on their view.

### Picard: display with side columns

A Titan.DS-style console: small dark utility pills housed in a bracket frame with red alert at the bottom, a [concentric](lcars-design#concentric-sweep) header sweep whose leg matches the [code-block](lcars-design#code-block-column) column, vertical gauges, a nested frame around a dimmed ship schematic, a right number column with a cascade, [toggle tabs](lcars-design#toggle-tab-strip) and gauges along the bottom.

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/picard-console.webm" poster="/gallery/picard-console.webp" title="Picard console: grey sweeps and columns of code blocks, red accents on the blocks and tabs that are on, a dimmed blue ship in a nested frame, vertical and horizontal gauges and a column of numbers" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Picard console: a Titan.DS-style screen built from the patterns in
# doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md. Utility pills housed in a bracket frame, a concentric header
# sweep whose leg matches the column of code blocks, a nested frame around a line-drawn ship,
# a right number column, toggle tabs and gauges along the bottom, a footer sweep.
# Every colour is a theme role (theme: tokens), so it follows the HA-LCARS theme.
# Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: Picard Console
views:
  - title: Console
    path: console
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 6px
      grid-template-columns: 130px 220px minmax(0, 1fr) 140px
      grid-template-rows: 90px minmax(0, 1fr) 56px 48px 48px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "pills top    top     top"
        "pills nums   main    rnums"
        "pills nums   tabs    rnums"
        "pills nums   gauges  rnums"
        "pills bottom bottom  bottom"
    cards:
      # Utility pills housed in a bracket frame (open on the left), red alert at the bottom.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: pills
        elbow:
          type: frame
          segment:
            color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
          frame:
            bar_width: 14
            bar_height: 36
            outer_curve: 36
            left:
              enabled: false
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: pills
        layout:
          padding: 46px 22px 46px 4px
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: 26px 26px 26px minmax(0, 1fr) 26px
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 26, text: { label: { content: ZOOM, show: true, position: center, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 26, text: { label: { content: ABOUT, show: true, position: center, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 26, text: { label: { content: DIMMER, show: true, position: center, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0 }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            min_height: 26
            text: { label: { content: RED ALERT, show: true, position: center } }
            style:
              card:
                color:
                  background:
                    default: var(--lcars-alert-color, var(--lcards-orange-dark))
            tap_action:
              action: perform-action
              perform_action: lcards.red_alert

      # Header: a concentric sweep (thick outer, thin inner line); its leg is as wide as the code column.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: top
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 6
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 220
              bar_height: 22
              color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 6
              bar_height: 4
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary
        text:
          title:
            content: U.S.S. TITAN · SYSTEMS
            position: bottom-right
            font_size: 30
            color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary

      # Left number column: mostly structure; the three with helpers light up when on.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: nums
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: repeat(7, 32px) minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 63-934, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 13-650, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 19-638, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 42-991, position: center-right } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 28
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights
            text: { label: { content: 28-130, position: center-right } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 50-957, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 81-782, position: center-right } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 28
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            text: { label: { content: 46-991, position: center-right } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 95-132, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 85-334, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 92-548, position: center-right } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: panel-light
            min_height: 28
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_toggle
            text: { label: { content: 97-747, position: center-right } }
            tap_action: { action: toggle }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 76-324, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 12-229, position: center-right } } }
          # Vertical gauges under the blocks, as on the Titan.DS consoles.
          - type: custom:lcards-slider
            component: picard
            preset: picard-gauge-vertical
            entity: input_number.lcards_test_power
          - type: custom:lcards-slider
            component: picard
            preset: picard-gauge-vertical
            entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields

      # Main display: a nested frame around the line-drawn ship.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:

          type: frame

            color: theme:colors.ui.primary

            bar_width: 12

              enabled: false

              gap: 6

                bar_width: 4
                color: theme:colors.card.topColor

        view_layout:
          grid-area: main

            source: builtin:ncc-1701-a-blue
            # Dimmed: the schematic is data, not structure.
            filters:
              - { mode: css, type: opacity, value: 0.45 }
          view_box: [180, 270, 1600, 720]

      # Right number column.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: rnums

          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: repeat(10, 32px) minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 82-947, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: NCC-80102, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 57-835, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 83-370, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 23-714, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 87-718, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 78-485, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 97-923, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 85-199, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 28, text: { label: { content: 74-700, position: center-right } } }
          # Numbers as texture in the space left over.
          - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
            data_mode: decorative
            format: digit

              grid-template-rows: repeat(10, auto)
              grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
              gap: 0px
            style:

                preset: cascade-color

      # Toggle tabs: state shows as a line along the top.

        view_layout:
```

### Picard: display over controls

A concentric header sweep continued by a [segmented bar](lcars-design#segmented-bar-classic-arms) of codes, a wide nested frame around a grey shuttle schematic, and a control deck under it: a [gauge bank](lcars-design#gauge-bank), a [tile wall](lcars-design#tile-wall), [readout rows](lcars-design#readout-rows) and a [selector strip](lcars-design#selector-strip).

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/picard-display.webm" poster="/gallery/picard-display.webp" title="Picard display: facing grey sweeps with a red title, a wide frame around a grey shuttlecraft schematic, four vertical gauges, four framed number tiles, three readout gauges and a mode selector" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Picard display: the "display over controls" archetype from doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md.
# Facing sweeps across the top, a wide nested frame around a dimmed ship schematic, and a
# control deck under it: a gauge bank, a wall of framed tiles, readout rows and a selector
# strip. Every colour is a theme role. Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: Picard Display
views:
  - title: Display
    path: display
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 8px
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr)
      grid-template-rows: 80px minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 48px
      grid-template-areas: |
        "headl   headl   headr"
        "display display display"
        "gauges  tiles   readout"
        "gauges  tiles   sel"
    cards:
      # Header: a concentric sweep with the title, continued by a segmented bar of codes.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: headl
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 6
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 150
              bar_height: 20
              color: theme:colors.ui.secondary
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 5
              bar_height: 4
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary
        text:
          title:
            content: DECK PLAN · SECTION 7
            position: bottom-right
            font_size: 28
            color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: headr
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 3fr 1fr
          grid-template-rows: 20px
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "47-2201", position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "08", position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "NAVIGATIONAL REFERENCE", position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 20, text: { label: { content: "541", position: center-right } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }

      # The display: a nested frame around the ship, dimmed so it reads as data.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: display
        elbow:
          type: frame
          style: segmented
          segment:
            color: theme:colors.card.topColor
          frame:
            bar_width: 8
            segments:
              gap: 6
              inner_frame:
                bar_width: 3
                color: theme:colors.ui.primary
      - type: custom:lcards-msd-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: display
        msd:
          base_svg:
            source: builtin:enterprise-d-shuttlecraft15-anomaly
            # Grey and dimmed: on a Picard screen the schematic is data, not structure.
            filters:
              - { mode: css, type: grayscale, value: 1 }
              - { mode: css, type: opacity, value: 0.55 }
          view_box: [-40, -50, 1123, 560]

      # Gauge bank.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: gauges
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr)
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_power }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_temperature }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, component: picard, preset: picard-gauge-vertical, entity: input_number.lcards_test_humidity }

      # Tile wall: framed readings, each embedded in its frame.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: tiles
        layout:
          grid-gap: 10px
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
          grid-template-rows: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.card.topColor }
              frame: { bar_width: 4, bar_height: 4, outer_curve: 10 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: digit
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.card.topColor }
              frame: { bar_width: 4, bar_height: 4, outer_curve: 10 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: hex
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment:
                color:
                  default: theme:colors.card.topColor
                  active: theme:colors.ui.tertiary
                  inactive: theme:colors.card.topColor
              frame: { bar_width: 4, bar_height: 4, outer_curve: 10 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: float
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.card.topColor }
              frame: { bar_width: 4, bar_height: 4, outer_curve: 10 }
            symbiont:
              enabled: true
              position: { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10 }
              imprint: { enabled: false }
              card:
                type: custom:lcards-data-grid
                data_mode: decorative
                format: alpha
                grid:
                  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto)
                  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))

      # Readout rows.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: readout
        layout:
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: POWER, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, preset: gauge-basic, entity: input_number.lcards_test_power }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: SHIELDS, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, preset: gauge-basic, entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: HUMIDITY, position: center-right } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-slider, preset: gauge-basic, entity: input_number.lcards_test_humidity }

      # Selector strip.
      - type: custom:lcards-select-menu
        view_layout:
          grid-area: sel
        entity: input_select.lcards_test_mode
        preset: toggle-tab
        grid:
          columns: 3
          gap: 6px
```

### Picard: split screen

A split header in the Picard style: two [segmented elbows](lcars-design#concentric-sweep) (a thin outer band with a large curve around a wide inner block) face each other across a cut through the screen, each band running on as thin segments. Utility pills sit inside the upper curve and [flagged blocks](lcars-design#flagged-blocks) inside the lower one, around readout gauges, a cascade, a radar scope and a framed ship schematic.

<video class="doc-video" src="/gallery/picard-split.webm" poster="/gallery/picard-split.webp" title="Picard split screen: two grey segmented sweeps facing across a cut through the screen, pills in the upper curve, flagged code blocks in the lower, readout gauges, a number cascade, a radar scope, a dimmed blue ship and toggle tabs" autoplay loop muted playsinline></video>

::: details YAML
```yaml
# Picard split: a split header in the Picard style, from doc/getting-started/lcars-design.md.
# Two segmented elbows (a thin outer band with a large curve around a wide inner block, as
# in the lcars-shell strategy) face each other across a cut through the screen; each band
# runs on as thin segments. Utility pills sit inside the upper curve, flagged code blocks
# inside the lower one. Every colour is a theme role. Uses lcards_test_* helpers.
title: Picard Split
views:
  - title: Split
    path: split
    type: custom:lcards-layout-view
    layout:
      height: calc(100dvh - var(--header-height, 56px))
      padding: 12px
      grid-gap: 8px
      grid-template-columns: 210px 130px minmax(0, 1fr) 280px
      grid-template-rows: 300px minmax(0, 1fr)
      grid-template-areas: |
        "ucorner ucorner upper upper"
        "lcorner lcorner lower lower"
    cards:
      # Upper half: a segmented elbow sweeping down into the cut.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: ucorner
        elbow:
          type: footer-left
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 5
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 40
              bar_height: 14
              outer_curve: 120
              inner_curve: 70
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 150
              bar_height: 30
              inner_curve: 30
              color: theme:colors.ui.quaternary
      # Utility pills inside the upper curve.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: ucorner
        layout:
          padding: 16px 12px 70px 210px
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: 26px 26px 26px minmax(0, 1fr) 26px
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 26, text: { label: { content: ZOOM, show: true, position: center, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 26, text: { label: { content: ABOUT, show: true, position: center, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: lozenge, min_height: 26, text: { label: { content: DIMMER, show: true, position: center, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.card.topColor } } } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: text-only, min_height: 0 }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            preset: lozenge
            min_height: 26
            text: { label: { content: RED ALERT, show: true, position: center } }
            style: { card: { color: { background: { default: "var(--lcars-alert-color, var(--lcards-orange-dark))" } } } }
            tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: lcards.red_alert }

      # Upper content, closed at the bottom by the band running on as thin segments.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: upper
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 280px
          grid-template-rows: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) 14px
          grid-template-areas: |
            "dots   title  title"
            "rows   cascade gauges"
            "s1     s2     s3"
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: dots }
            preset: text-only
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: "•  •••  ••  •••••  •  ••", show: true, position: center-left, color: theme:colors.ui.secondary } }
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: title }
            preset: text-only
            min_height: 0
            text: { label: { content: "U.S.S. TITAN · OPERATIONS", show: true, position: center-right, font_size: 32, color: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } }
          - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
            view_layout: { grid-area: rows }
            layout:
              grid-gap: 6px
              grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 1fr)
              grid-template-rows: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))
            cards:
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: POWER, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-slider, preset: gauge-basic, entity: input_number.lcards_test_power }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: SHIELDS, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-slider, preset: gauge-basic, entity: input_number.lcards_test_shields }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 0, text: { label: { content: HUMIDITY, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-slider, preset: gauge-basic, entity: input_number.lcards_test_humidity }
          - type: custom:lcards-data-grid
            view_layout: { grid-area: cascade }
            data_mode: decorative
            format: digit
            grid:
              grid-template-rows: repeat(6, auto)
              grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
              gap: 0px
            style:
              padding: 0px
              font_size: 18px
            animations:
              - trigger: on_load
                preset: cascade-color
          - type: custom:lcards-button
            view_layout: { grid-area: gauges }
            component: radar
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 14, view_layout: { grid-area: s1 }, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 14, view_layout: { grid-area: s2 }, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 14, view_layout: { grid-area: s3 }, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } }, style: { card: { color: { background: { default: theme:colors.ui.tertiary } } } } }

      # Lower half: the mirror elbow sweeping up out of the cut.
      - type: custom:lcards-elbow
        view_layout:
          grid-area: lcorner
        elbow:
          type: header-left
          style: segmented
          segments:
            gap: 5
            outer_segment:
              bar_width: 40
              bar_height: 14
              outer_curve: 120
              inner_curve: 70
              color: theme:colors.ui.primary
            inner_segment:
              bar_width: 150
              bar_height: 30
              inner_curve: 30
              color: theme:colors.ui.quaternary
      # Flagged code blocks inside the lower curve; two follow helpers.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: lcorner
        layout:
          padding: 70px 12px 16px 210px
          grid-gap: 6px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 30px)
        cards:
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: "012" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_lights, tap_action: { action: toggle }, text: { label: { content: "330" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: "436" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, entity: input_boolean.lcards_test_doors, tap_action: { action: toggle }, text: { label: { content: "23" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: "542" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: "7439" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: "4057" } } }
          - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-flagged, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: "0007" } } }

      # Lower content: the band runs on as thin segments along the top, then a framed
      # display and a column of blocks and tabs.
      - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
        view_layout:
          grid-area: lower
        layout:
          grid-gap: 8px
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 280px
          grid-template-rows: 14px minmax(0, 1fr)
          grid-template-areas: |
            "segs segs"
            "display side"
        cards:
          - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
            view_layout: { grid-area: segs }
            layout:
              grid-gap: 6px
              grid-template-columns: 3fr 1fr 5fr 2fr
              grid-template-rows: 14px
            cards:
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 14, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 14, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 14, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 14, text: { label: { content: "", show: false } } }
          - type: custom:lcards-elbow
            view_layout: { grid-area: display }
            elbow:
              type: frame
              segment: { color: theme:colors.card.topColor }
              frame: { bar_width: 3, bar_height: 3, outer_curve: 24 }
          - type: custom:lcards-msd-card
            view_layout: { grid-area: display }
            msd:
              base_svg:
                source: builtin:ncc-1701-a-blue
                filters:
                  - { mode: css, type: opacity, value: 0.45 }
              view_box: [180, 270, 1600, 720]
          - type: custom:lcards-layout-card
            view_layout: { grid-area: side }
            layout:
              grid-gap: 6px
              grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
              grid-template-rows: repeat(6, 30px) minmax(0, 1fr) 48px 48px
            cards:
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: 58-347, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: NCC-80102, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: 45-721, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-light, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: 10-732, position: center-right } } }
              - { type: custom:lcards-button, preset: panel-dark, min_height: 30, text: { label: { content: 52-741, position: center-right } } }
```
